title: VIXEN preset commands need a working-directory guard
body: The documented VIXEN configure preset lives under VIXEN/, but invoking cmake --preset vixen-wsl from the repository root fails with a missing CMakePresets.json before configuration. A wrapper or preset entrypoint should resolve the source directory or emit a direct correction.

title: GPU editor witness needs a root-relative environment launcher
body: The queued windowed editor witness failed before launch when invoked from the repository root because vixen-gpu-env.sh and appflow_client were only addressed relative to VIXEN; the workaround is to run from VIXEN or resolve both paths from the repository root.
